title: استراتيجية مصر الرقمية
why_not: A thinner overview of the same strategy as the ICT_Strategy page selected as baseline; the fuller page wins

title: MCIT Yearbook 2025
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
why_not: The URL serves a publications index carrying blurbs for several yearbooks, not the 2025 yearbook document itself

title: PROTOCOL TO THE AGREEMENT ESTABLISHING THE AFRICAN CONTINENTAL FREE TRADE AREA ON DIGITAL TRADE
why_not: Egypt's own Law 151 of 2020 is the operative cross-border transfer rule; the Protocol is adopted but not ratified by Egypt. Staged once, as the baseline for regional legal harmonisation.

title: EGYPT - 2025 Survey on Public Access to Information (SDG Indicator 16.10.2)
why_not: Fetched at 200 but the PDF carries a custom font encoding and its extracted text is unreadable mojibake throughout, so no verbatim body could be taken from it.

title: Measuring digital development: The affordability of ICT services 2024
why_not: The current edition of the series, but Egypt appears in it only as the address of the ITU regional office; it carries no Egypt price-basket row, so it cannot serve as the numeric baseline.

title: ITU Statistics Update - December 2025
why_not: Announces the release of the 2025 ICT price statistics but contains no Egypt content at all; staging it under a country place would put an Egypt citation on a body that never mentions Egypt.

title: قرار رقم 816 لسنة 2025 بإصدار اللائحة التنفيذية لقانون حماية البيانات الشخصية
why_not: A governance requirement bearing on recoverability rather than a movement in backup capacity; the two data-centre events move this indicator further. Staged once, as progress for cross-border data transfers.

title: Tracking SDG 7: The Energy Progress Report 2024
publisher: IEA, IRENA, UNSD, World Bank and WHO
why_not: The authoritative access series, but Egypt appears in it only in finance-flow passages and country lists; it carries no Egypt rural-access row, so it does not establish the baseline figure.

title: عن النظام
publisher: الهيئة العامة للتأمين الصحي الشامل (Universal Health Insurance Authority)
why_not: A navigation page linking to Law 2 of 2018 and its executive regulation rather than the instrument or any statement of the health data layer; the Egypt Healthcare Authority statement was the stronger baseline.

title: ICT Sector Achievements in 2025
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (Egypt)
why_not: The lead claimed the expatriate-services phase covered birth certificates; the fetched body says only four types of previously issued documents and never names birth certificates, so it does not evidence movement on digital id from birth. Staged and selected under dpi.id--national-maintenance-of-id-and-credentials-systems instead.

title: تعرف على إجراءات إعادة قيد الميلاد والوفاة وتسجيل الأحكام
why_not: Fetched in full; excluded by the cap - a news account of Civil Status Organisation re-registration procedures, weaker than the CAPMAS bulletin release and the MCIT expatriate civil-status service

title: Law No. 198 for the year 2017 on the National Election Authority
why_not: Fetched in full; excluded by the one-baseline cap - it constitutes the Authority, whereas Decree-Law 45/2014 constitutes the register itself

title: قرار الهيئة الوطنية للانتخابات رقم 2 لسنة 2026
why_not: Fetched; a 317-character landing page whose decision PDF is image-only with no text layer, and the same event as the selected participation statistics

title: قرارات بشأن انتخابات مجلس النواب 2025
why_not: Fetched; an index of decision titles with no document body of its own, and decision 38/2025's own PDF returns 404

title: The Ministry of Education has extended the deadline for online registration
publisher: Ministry of Education and Technical Education (Egypt)
why_not: A two-paragraph administrative notice extending an exam registration deadline to 12 February 2026. Operation of an existing channel, not a movement in the education management information system.

title: Nafeza Platform - Advance Cargo Information System (Aviation)
why_not: Official statement that Aviation ACI trial operation runs to 31/12/2025 and mandatory operation starts 01/01/2026, but the page carries no publication date and none could be established from it, so the movement cannot be dated from the document. The dated NAFEZA news item announcing the preparatory workshop is 22 August 2025, before the window.

title: Digital Egypt Cubs Initiative (DECI)
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT), Egypt
why_not: Fetched; an undated programme page covering preparatory to secondary students, not rural primary schools, and carrying no dated in-window movement

title: National AI Strategy – Second Edition 2025-2030
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT), Egypt
why_not: MCIT publication landing page for the strategy; the primary document itself was fetched from that page own download link and staged instead.

title: قانون رقم 164 لسنة 2024 بإصدار قانون لجوء الأجانب
why_not: The founding act, but the Gazette scan embedded font yields about 6 per cent replacement characters on every extractor tried, so the operative executive regulations were staged as baseline in clean official text instead.

title: الأهداف الاستراتيجية
publisher: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS), Egypt
why_not: Lists the six objectives of the National Strategy for Official Statistics but is undated apart from a 2012 site copyright, so the dated ministerial statement of current position was preferred as baseline.
